title: FBI Investigates Apparent Cyberattack Targeting National Crime Information Center
summary: Federal investigators are examining a reported intrusion involving the NCIC database. The scope and any potential exposure of records remain unclear.

title: Mamdani's Past Protest Arrests Draw Attention as NYC Disbands NYPD Strategic Response Group
summary: New York City has announced the disbandment of the NYPD Strategic Response Group, while reporting has highlighted Mayor Mamdani's earlier encounters with its officers.

title: Reporters Asked to Secure China-Used Phones in Faraday Bags on Air Force One
summary: A White House press pool account describes a cybersecurity precaution during the flight from China, with journalists asked to secure devices used during the visit.

title: Iran Warns of Strikes on U.S. Military Bases if American Attacks Resume
summary: Iranian security chief Mohsen Rezaei warns that U.S. bases, including facilities in Europe, could face retaliation if used to launch new strikes against Iran.

title: Why Power Outages Can Knock Internet Networks Offline
summary: A new Cloudflare review shows how electricity failures, damaged fiber networks and policy decisions disrupted internet connectivity around the world.

title: U.S. Airlines Recover as FAA Communications Failure Raises Infrastructure Questions
summary: Air travel is recovering after a nationwide FAA ground stop, while investigators examine whether a router installed during modernization work caused the disruption.

title: European Aviation Agency Extends Middle East Airspace Warnings Amid Regional Conflict
summary: European aviation authorities have updated conflict-zone warnings covering Iran and neighboring airspace as missile and drone threats continue.

title: Iran Claims Drone Strikes on Bahrain as U.S. Disputes Reported Damage
summary: Iran says it targeted military facilities in Bahrain in retaliation for U.S. strikes; American and Bahraini officials report interceptions and dispute Iranian claims of damage.

title: FBI Warns ARTEX AI Framework Is Being Weaponized to Accelerate Cyber Intrusions
summary: A November 13 FBI FLASH advisory warns that attackers are using the ARTEX agentic framework to automate stages of cyber intrusions, sometimes reaching privileged access in under three hours.

title: FAA Orders Nationwide Ground Stop After Communications Outage Disrupts U.S. Air Travel
summary: A communications failure affecting 22 regional air traffic control centers prompted an FAA nationwide ground stop Friday, disrupting thousands of flights as officials investigated the cause.

title: Flying Tentacles Over Alaska? Viral 'Jellyfish UFO' Video May Show an Octopus Kite
summary: A tentacled object filmed over Anchorage on June 15 resurfaced in November. Investigators say an octopus-shaped kite is plausible, but the object's identity remains unconfirmed.

title: Arizona Governor Katie Hobbs Names Kori Lorick Next Chief of Staff
summary: Governor Katie Hobbs announced that Chad Campbell will depart at the end of November and Kori Lorick will become chief of staff, as Arizona's administration prepares for its next term.

title: Schwarzenegger and Newsom Share Stage to Mark 20 Years of California’s Landmark Climate Law
summary: Former Republican Gov. Arnold Schwarzenegger and Democratic Gov. Gavin Newsom joined a Long Beach panel on October 14 to discuss two decades of California climate policy, bipartisan cooperation and the challenges ahead.

title: House Blocks Pete Hegseth Impeachment Effort in 211–204 Vote as Congressional Scrutiny Continues
summary: The House referred Rep. Thomas Massie's impeachment resolution against Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth to committee, halting the effort for now as lawmakers debate the Iran war and Pentagon oversight.

title: Usman Nurmagomedov Reportedly Among Those Sentenced After Abu Dhabi Hotel Brawl
summary: An Abu Dhabi court convicted 10 defendants after a brawl involving Usman Nurmagomedov and Merab Dvalishvili. Reports identify Nurmagomedov among those receiving six-month prison sentences.

title: Democrats Outline 2027 Congressional Priorities After Midterm Gains
summary: Following November's midterm elections, Democrats are preparing proposals on healthcare, costs, government ethics and the Iran war as Republicans assess their next steps.

title: NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang Resigns; Colette Kress Named Interim Leader Amid Security Investigation
summary: NVIDIA confirms Jensen Huang's departure, appoints CFO Colette Kress as interim CEO, and continues a separate investigation into reported foreign-intelligence targeting.
